reason: The query at packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:44-51 does lack method/scheduled filters, but `cancelled: true` is only ever written at packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:225-232, after the `!referenceId` early-return delete at :203-211, and every caller invokes it only when `reminder.method === WorkflowMethods.EMAIL` (SMS reminders are deleted outright in smsReminderManager.ts). So no SMS or null-referenceId reminder can be cancelled and reach the SendGrid call at :57-64; the missing filter is a defensive gap, not a reachable bug.
